title: Later phase: make customer-account computers' files editable (overlay in the customer bucket)
description:
Later phase. Make customer-account computers editable (view is already supported from the snapshot).

Why they are read-only in Phase 3 (docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md L46, 12.8): they run in the customer's own AWS account through the older host-worker path, with the customer-owned bucket chatticus-snapshots-{OrganizationId} (docs/COMPUTER_SNAPSHOTS.md). The Front Door's overlay write grant names only the Anthus snapshot bucket, so it cannot write an overlay there, and the host that would apply one is a host worker with no supervisor: nothing seals, applies or clears. An edit, delete, rename or new folder is refused with 409 edit_unsupported.

Needed: (1) a cross-account write grant for the Front Door to overlay/* of the customer bucket through the existing customer role (infra/customer-role.yml, customer-computers-stack.ts); (2) the overlay protocol in the host worker (seal, apply in the order of 7.8.5, clear after a recorded publish) or a supervisor on that path; (3) the 30 day non-current version expiry in the customer's stack; (4) front-door-composition: a snapshot/overlay store per organization home instead of the single Anthus bucket (lambdas/front-door-composition.ts:216); (5) scenarios for the customer path.

Depends on: Phase 3 parts F0, A3, A2, A4, C2 merged and live. Not started; priority low.
